aamon.name: Invisible Armor
aamon.description: Aamon enters the Camouflage state each time he hits an enemy with a skill, during which he cannot be targeted, restores 25 (+15% Total Magic Power) (+3% of Aamon's Lost HP) HP every 0.6 seconds, and gains 60% extra Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3.5 seconds. Upon leaving the Camouflage state, Aamon immediately resets his Basic Attack's cooldown and enhances his Basic Attacks within the next 2.5 seconds. Each enhanced Basic Attack deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and reduces Aamon's skill cooldowns by 0.5 second. The first enhanced Basic Attack's damage is increased to 120% if Aamon leaves the Camouflage state actively.

aamon.name: Soul Shards
aamon.description: Passive: Aamon charges his armor through enhanced Basic Attacks or while camouflaged. At 5 charges, Aamon throws 6 shards at the target on his next attack, each shard dealing 50 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The shards will then scatter around the target. Active: Aamon throws a shard at a nearby enemy, dealing 175 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

aamon.name: Slayer Shards
aamon.description: Aamon throws a shard forward, dealing 120 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies hit by 50% for 2s. The shard returns to Aamon after a short delay, granting him the Camouflage state. If the shard hits a non-minion enemy, it returns immediately.

aamon.name: Endless Shards
aamon.description: Aamon throws all shards at a designated enemy and slows them by 30% for 1.5s. After a short delay, the shards will fly to the enemy's location again, each dealing 35 (+10% Total Magic Power)-70 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The number of shards increases with Aamon's armor charges and the shards on the ground (8-25). The damage dealt increases with the target's lost HP, to the max when the target's HP is below 30%.

akai.name: Tai Chi
akai.description: Akai gains a 25 (+5% Max HP) shield for 4s on each skill cast. His skills apply a Mark to targets. His next Basic Attack against a marked target deals 35 (+6% Max HP) extra Physical Damage.

akai.name: Headbutt
akai.description: Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. Upon hitting an enemy hero, he knocks them airborne for 0.5s and can roll once in the joystick's direction. Akai can cast Headbutt during Heavy Spin to quickly reposition himself.

akai.name: Body Slam
akai.description: Akai slams his body into the ground, dealing 270 (+6% Max HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.

akai.name: Heavy Spin
akai.description: Akai spins for 4s, continuously dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Knocked-back enemy heroes also knock back any enemy heroes they collide with. Upon casting, Akai removes all debuffs and gains slow immunity. While spinning, his Movement Speed gradually increases to 70%. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

aldous.name: Contract: Transform
aldous.description: Every 8s, Aldous gains a shield equal to 350 (+ 3 per Soul Steal stack) for 3s on his next Basic Attack. He also gains 60% Movement Speed for 1s.

aldous.name: Contract: Soul Steal
aldous.description: Aldous enhances his next Basic Attack to deal 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+ 3 per Soul Steal stack) Physical Damage. Killing a siege minion with this attack grants 12 Soul Steal stacks; killing any other non-hero unit grants 5 stacks. Hitting an enemy hero grants an extra 5 stack(s), while killing one grants 12 (up to 1000 stacks). This attack deals 300% extra Base Damage to minions and creeps. Aldous also gains 6 stack(s) when allied units eliminate a nearby enemy siege minion, and 2 stack(s) when they eliminate any other nearby non-hero unit. Aldous gains 20% Movement Speed while moving toward enemy heroes during this skill.

aldous.name: Contract: Explosion
aldous.description: Aldous assumes a defensive stance, gaining 30% Damage Reduction for 2s or until canceled. He then deals 200 (+20% Total Physical Attack)-400 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.5-1s (scales with defensive stance duration).

aldous.name: Contract: Chase Fate
aldous.description: Aldous gains vision of all enemy heroes for 5s. Use Again: During this time, he dashes toward an enemy hero, dealing 250 (+ 8% target's HP) Physical Damage and knocking the target back for 1s. Aldous can interrupt the target's Recall while dashing.

alice.name: Crimson Blood Banquet
alice.description: Alice gains 1 stack(s) of Crimson each time her skill hits an enemy, lasting 4s (up to 2 stacks). Blood Banquet activates at max stacks. Blood Banquet: Every 0.5s, Alice deals 25 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+ 0.5% - 2.5% target's HP, scaling with level) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. She also recovers 10 (+3% Extra Max HP) HP and gains 8% Movement Speed. Its duration is refreshed when her skills hit an enemy hero. Damage to creeps is capped at 70 (+10*Hero Level) Magic Damage.

alice.name: Crimson Gleam
alice.description: Alice shoots Blood Energy forward, dealing 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies. Use Again: Before Blood Energy dissipates, Alice can recast this skill as Scarlet Shadow to blink to its location.

alice.name: Doom Waltz
alice.description: Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s. If Blood Banquet is active, the skill also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of Blood Banquet's damage and recovering the same amount of HP.

alice.name: Throne of Ruin
alice.description: Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%. After 1.5s, she descends from above, dealing 500 (+200% Total Magic Power) (+20% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s. While charging her Ultimate, Alice cannot use any hero skills other than Scarlet Shadow.

alpha.name: Beta, Advance!
alpha.description: When Alpha uses a skill, Beta will be summoned to attack. Enemies that are hit by Beta 2 time(s) will be Locked On. Locked On: After Alpha deals damage to the target, Beta will fire a laser at them, dealing 60 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+8*Hero Level) True Damage and briefly applying a powerful slow effect. This skill only deals 75% damage to Creeps.

alpha.name: Rotary Impact
alpha.description: Alpha unleashes an energy wave in the target direction, dealing 100 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 1s. Beta then strafes enemies along the same path, dealing 60 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage.

alpha.name: Force Swing
alpha.description: After a short delay, Alpha swings his blade in the target direction, dealing 180 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and recovering 80 (+40% Extra Physical Attack) HP for the first enemy hit (healing decays by 40% for each additional enemy hit). Beta then strafes enemies in the same area, dealing 60 (+30% Total Physical Attack) True Damage.

alpha.name: Spear of Alpha
alpha.description: Beta dives to the target location, dealing 100 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s. Alpha then leaps towards the same location, knocking enemies in his path airborne and carrying them to the landing location. Alpha then slams down, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 40% for 1.5s. Beta then attacks the same area 5 times, dealing 15 (+30% Extra Physical Attack) True Damage each time.

alucard.name: Pursuit
alucard.description: After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Demon Hunter: Alucard deals 110% damage to Creeps.

alucard.name: Groundsplitter
alucard.description: Alucard jumps to the target area and slashes, dealing 270 (+85% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within the area and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

alucard.name: Whirling Smash
alucard.description: Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

alucard.name: Fission Wave
alucard.description: Passive: Alucard permanently gains 10% Hybrid Lifesteal. Active: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10. He gains 10 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s. Use Again: Alucard releases a powerful shockwave forward, dealing 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

angela.name: Smart Heart
angela.description: Angela gains 5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 20%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

angela.name: Love Waves
angela.description: Angela sends Love Waves in the target direction, dealing 170 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of Lover's Mark (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s. Love Waves also restore 150 (+75% Total Magic Power) HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill, and the charge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction. When attached to allies, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

angela.name: Puppet-on-a-String
angela.description: Angela launches a Puppet String at the target enemy (excluding minions), dealing 300 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and take 450 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Each stack of Lover's Mark increases the final damage by 20%.

angela.name: Heartguard
angela.description: Angela begins channeling, applying a 600 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield to the target allied hero regardless of distance. Once attached to an ally, the shield remains until detached. After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 20s, during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost. Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.

argus.name: Warmonger
argus.description: Malice Energy grants Argus an initial Crit Chance of 30%. Instead of dealing normal critical damage, Argus's Crits are converted into Demonic Slash, which ignores 30% of the target's Physical Defense, deals 90 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, and recovers 140 HP. Demonic Slash cannot Crit, but can still trigger Crit-related effects.

argus.name: Demonic Grip
argus.description: First Cast: Argus extends a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero or creep hit and stunning them for 0.7s. Argus and the target are pulled toward each other, and the target is slowed by 40% for 2s. If no enemy is hit, Argus is pulled to the hand's endpoint instead. Use Again: Argus dashes forward and performs a wide slash, dealing 175 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area.

argus.name: Meteoric Sword
argus.description: After a short charge, Argus thrusts his Meteoric Sword in the target direction, dealing 120 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target. If this hits an enemy hero, Argus stuns them for 0.3s and gains 30% Attack Speed for 3s. Meteoric Sword's damage also gains a 40% boost to Crit Chance and Crit Damage. Meteoric Sword counts as a Basic Attack and can trigger Attack Effects. Attack Speed shortens the charge time.

argus.name: Eternal Evil
argus.description: Argus removes all control effects, gains Death Immunity for 4s, and deals 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. This damage increases as Argus's Current HP decreases, reaching 150% when it falls below 30%. When Death Immunity ends, Argus recovers HP equal to all damage dealt to enemy heroes during its duration. Passive: If Argus takes fatal damage while Eternal Evil is not on cooldown, he removes all control effects and automatically enters Death Immunity without triggering AOE Damage.

arlott.name: Demon Gaze
arlott.description: Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will Mark enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s. The eye will also automatically Mark a nearby enemy hero in vision every 7s.

arlott.name: Dauntless Strike
arlott.description: Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning targets in an area. Targets hit by the farther part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

arlott.name: Vengeance
arlott.description: Arlott charges at an enemy, dealing 135 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement). If Arlott's target is Marked, he gains a brief burst of Movement Speed, and this skill will deal double damage, immediately refresh its cooldown, and recover 70 (+60% Total Physical Attack) HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).

arlott.name: Final Slash
arlott.description: Passive: Each level-up reduces Demon Gaze's interval by 1s. Active: Arlott cleaves forward, dealing 400 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area, knocking them back to the edge of the swing, and briefly revealing their location (can only be interrupted by Suppression).

atlas.name: Frigid Breath
atlas.description: Atlas generates Frigid Breath around him for 4s each time he casts a skill. Enemies affected by Frigid Breath will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 2s, after which they'll be frozen for 0.5s. Atlas gains 20 (+0.5% Extra Max HP) extra Hybrid Defense when Frigid Breath is present.

atlas.name: Annihilate
atlas.description: Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies. Ejected State: If Atlas is ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both he and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

atlas.name: Perfect Match
atlas.description: Atlas enters Ejected State, gaining 30% Movement Speed and immunity to Slowing Effects. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby and stunning them for 0.8s. Ejected State: Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar and reduce 50% of the damage taken in this state.

atlas.name: Fatal Links
atlas.description: Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 225 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3s. Release the skill while channeling: Atlas will drag the targets toward him and plunk them down on the designated location, dealing 360 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Use this skill in Ejected State: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% Slowing Effect.

aulus.name: Fighting Spirit
aulus.description: Whenever Aulus deals skill damage to a unit, he gains an enhanced Basic Attack for 2s (capped at 4s). Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus raises his axe and slams it into the ground, dealing 120 (+12*Hero Level) (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line and recovering 15 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP. Enemies hit are slowed by 10% for 1s. Aulus also gains 0.5 Attack Range and 20% Attack Speed for 1s. Enhanced Basic Attack deals 240 (+24*Hero Level) (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to creeps.

aulus.name: Aulus, Charge!
aulus.description: Aulus starts accumulating Fighting Spirit, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5s. If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the Enraged state and gain Control Immunity.

aulus.name: The Power of Axe
aulus.description: Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and stunning them for 0.3s. Use Again: Aulus dashes forward and smashes the ground, dealing 240 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

aulus.name: Cleaving Axe
aulus.description: Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 450 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a large area. During this skill, Aulus gains 20% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.

aurora.name: Pride of Ice
aurora.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Aurora freezes herself for 1.5s, becoming invincible during this time and gradually recovering 30% HP. This effect has a 150s cooldown. Aurora's freeze effects can also affect Turrets.

aurora.name: Hailstone Blast
aurora.description: Aurora summons an icy meteorite to strike at the target location, dealing 400 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1s. Afterward, 5 hailstones fall, each dealing 40 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.

aurora.name: Frosty Breeze
aurora.description: Aurora blows Frosty Breeze in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, dealing 225 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and creating a frozen area at the far end. The area deals a total of 225 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and freezes them for 1s (increases by 0.06s for every 100 Magic Power).

aurora.name: Frigid Glacier
aurora.description: Aurora creates a frost path in the target direction, dealing 100 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the path and slowing them by 80% for 1.2s. The frost path gradually expands into a glacier that shatters at maximum size, dealing 600 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area and freezing them for 1s (increases by 0.2s for every 100 Magic Power).

badang.name: Chivalry Fist
badang.description: Every time Badang's Basic Attack hits a target, he gains a stack of Chivalry Fist. After gaining 4 stacks, his next Basic Attack deals 50 (+30% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (Minions and Creeps are stunned directly). Fist Wind generated by Badang's skills will trigger this effect directly, and Fist Wind from his Ultimate increases the stun duration to 1s.

badang.name: Fist Wind
badang.description: Badang unleashes a gust of Fist Wind in the target direction, dealing 125 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The Fist Wind will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Fist Wind can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 Chivalry Fist stack upon cast. Badang stores up to 2 Fist Wind charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.

badang.name: Fist Break
badang.description: Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path while gaining a 350 (+150% Total Physical Attack) shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Use Again: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

badang.name: Fist Crack
badang.description: Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60 (+54% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The Fist Wind generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30 (+27% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.

balmond.name: Bloodthirst
balmond.description: Balmond recovers 5% HP upon killing a minion or creep, and 10% HP upon a hero kill or assist.

balmond.name: Soul Lock
balmond.description: Balmond charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He stops upon hitting an enemy hero, knocking them back and slowing them by 40% for 3s.

balmond.name: Cyclone Sweep
balmond.description: Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 30 (+1.3% Max HP) (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times. Each hit reduces the target's Physical Defense by 5% (up to 40%).

balmond.name: Lethal Counter
balmond.description: Balmond unleashes a powerful strike in a target direction, dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+ 30% of the target's lost HP) as True Damage. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression. Damage dealt to non-hero units is capped at 1000 True Damage.

bane.name: Shark Bite
bane.description: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of Tidal Energy each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal Physical Damage equal to (+95% Total Physical Attack) plus 4 (+0.4*Hero Level) of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies. (Percent damage dealt based on Max HP Damage Cap against Creeps: 200 (+20*Hero Level). (see Patch Notes 1.7.82 Balance Adjustment))

bane.name: Crab Claw Cannon
bane.description: Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10 (+10% Total Magic Power)% for 1s. Every 100 Physical Attack Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

bane.name: Sea Ink
bane.description: Bane swallows a cup of sea ink, recovering HP equal to 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) + 5 (+1.5% Total Magic Power)% of his , and gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s. Use Again: Bane spits corrosive ink in a fan-shaped area, dealing 140 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (up to 200% with charging time). Every 100 Magic Power Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 7%.

bane.name: Deadly Catch
bane.description: Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 700 (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.6s, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3s). This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.

barats.name: Big Guy
barats.description: Detona gains a stack of Big Guy for 12 seconds each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of Big Guy increases Detona's size, and grants 4–10 extra Hybrid Defense (scales with the level of Detona's Welcome) and 5% extra Resilience. At max stacks, Detona's Basic Attacks will be replaced with Trample, which deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+3.5% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2 seconds, and refreshes the duration of Big Guy with each hit.

barats.name: So-Called Teamwork
barats.description: Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60 (+7% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area (only 50% damage to Creeps). The area of effect of So-Called Teamwork increases with the number of Big Guy stacks.

barats.name: Missile "Expert"
barats.description: Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 40% for 1s. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing 100 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

barats.name: Detona's Welcome
barats.description: After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120 (+70% Total Physical Attack) (+1.2% Max HP) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2s, then spitting them out. If the spat‑out target hits an enemy hero or a wall, it triggers an explosion. The target and nearby enemies take an additional 180 (+105% Total Physical Attack) (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage and are stunned for 1s. During the skill, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the cast is canceled or the skill misses, 50% of the skill cooldown is refunded. If Detona successfully devours an enemy, he immediately gains max stacks of Big Guy.

baxia.name: Baxia Mark
baxia.description: Baxia activates the "Baxia Mark" permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15 (+1*Hero Level). At the same time, Baxia will reduce the Shield and HP Regen of enemies hit by his skills by 40% for 4s.

baxia.name: Baxia-Shield Unity
baxia.description: Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking nearby enemies back. During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike this hero, dealing 375 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the target hit for 1.5s, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.

baxia.name: Shield of Spirit
baxia.description: Baxia throws out his shield, dealing 120 (+100% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's HP) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep. Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep is hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.

baxia.name: Tortoise’s Puissance
baxia.description: Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10s while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s. For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from Baxia Mark is increased to 200%.

beatrix.name: Mechanical Genius
beatrix.description: Her extraordinary talent in the field of mechanics allowed Beatrix to produce 4 weapon(s) of truly awe-inspiring firepower. Renner Basic Attack - Longshot: Fire a powerful shot in the enemy's current direction, dealing (+-535% of 360% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first target hit (this shot can be dodged, or blocked by others. Deals 50% damage to creeps). Beatrix cannot crit, and converts every 1% Critical Chance gained into 2 Physical Attack

beatrix.name: Masterful Gunner
beatrix.description: Passive: Beatrix can carry 2 weapons at once, increasing her Physical Attack by 5. Active: Beatrix takes 0.5s to swap her primary weapon with the secondary weapon, gaining a new Basic Attack and Ultimate.

beatrix.name: Tactical Reposition
beatrix.description: Beatrix rolls forward while fully reloading her current weapon.

beatrix.name: Renner's Apathy
beatrix.description: Beatrix calmly sets up Renner on the battlefield and takes aim. When releasing the skill, she deals 700 (+280% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit. Beatrix can aim for up to 8s, and she can cancel it early to reduce the cooldown by 50%. This shot can penetrate Minions and only deals 75% damage to non-hero units.

belerick.name: Deadly Thorns
belerick.description: Whenever Belerick takes 50 or more damage, he has a 25% chance to shoot the nearest enemy unit, dealing 55 (+5*Hero Level) (+ 1.8% of his HP) Magic Damage (scales with level). This attack can be triggered once every 0.4s. His HP obtained from equipment and emblems is increased by 30%.

belerick.name: Ancient Seed
belerick.description: Belerick releases vines in a designated direction, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the path and slowing them by 25%. Ancient Seeds left by the vines will erupt into thorns after 0.8s, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on the path and taunting them for 1.2s. Deals 80% extra damage against Minions.

belerick.name: Nature's Strike
belerick.description: Belerick increases his Movement Speed by 80% and strengthens his next Basic Attack. (The Movement Speed gain will decay in 2 seconds.) This enhanced Basic Attack deals 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows the target by 60% for 1.4 seconds. Belerick also regenerates HP equal to 240 plus 10% of his lost HP. Each time Deadly Thorns is triggered, reduce the cooldown of this skill by 1s.

belerick.name: Wrath of Dryad
belerick.description: Belerick conjures spreading vines around him, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area 4 times, taunting and slowing them for 1.5s.

benedetta.name: Elapsed Daytime
benedetta.description: When holding down the Basic Attack button, Benedetta enters the Swordout state and charges up Sword Intent. If the Basic Attack button released after the Sword Intent is fully charged, Benedetta will use Swordout Slash in the direction she's facing and dash forward, dealing (+215% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on the path (counts as Skill Damage and is reduced to 50% on Minions and Creeps) Benedetta can only use Swordout Slash when her Sword Intent is fully charged and she is in Swordout state by holding down the Basic Attack button. Benedetta also gains Sword Intent by dealing damage with her Basic Attacks and skills.

benedetta.name: Phantom Slash
benedetta.description: Benedetta withdraws swiftly and leaves a shadow in front. After a short delay, her shadow slashes forward in a fan-shaped area, dealing 200 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 60% for 0.5s. Meanwhile, Benedetta dashes forward to slash, dealing 75 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. (If the target is hit by her shadow, damage caused by Benedetta herself will increase to 200%.)

benedetta.name: An Eye for An Eye
benedetta.description: Benedetta raises her weapon to defend, gaining Control Immunity and blocking damage from any source for 0.8s. After this, she stabs in the designated direction, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If Benedetta successfully fends off any damage while defending, she will gain full Sword Intent. If she fends off any control effects, her subsequent stab stuns the target for 1.5s.

benedetta.name: Alecto: Final Blow
benedetta.description: Benedetta clenches Alecto, dashes forward (Benedetta is untargetable during the dash), and performs a slash after a short delay, detonating the Sword Intent along the path. For 2.5s, the Sword Intent deals up to a total of 1560 (+1105% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and slows them by 50%.

brody.name: Abyss Corrosion
brody.description: With his Basic Attacks resonated with the Abyss Power within his body, Brody is able to move while winding up his Basic Attack (which will be interrupted when casting skills), at the cost of having longer Basic Attack Animation and lower Attack Speed. Each Basic Attack deals (+140% Total Physical Attack) (+45*Hero Level) Physical Damage (of which the damage scaling with level cannot be critical), increases Movement Speed by 30% (which will decay rapidly in 1.2 seconds), and inflicts 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the enemy, capped at 4 stacks. [Marks applied last for 8 seconds.] Each stack of Abyss Mark increases Brody's damage against the target by 5% and his Movement Speed by 5%.

brody.name: Abyss Impact
brody.description: Brody launches a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 200 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 1.2s while applying one stack of Abyss Mark. For each enemy hit by the shockwave, they take an extra 5% slow and one extra Abyss Mark stack (capped at 45% slow and 4 stacks).

brody.name: Corrosive Strike
brody.description: Brody dashes to an enemy, dealing 200 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, stunning the target for 0.8s, and applying 1 stack of Abyss Mark on the target. Upon hitting the target, he is able to move one more time in the movement direction, gaining 45% Movement Speed that will decay rapidly in 1.2s.

brody.name: Torn-Apart Memory
brody.description: Brody locks onto all enemies within 8 unit(s), dealing 216 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them. For each target with Abyss Mark stacks, all stacks are consumed, dealing additional Physical Damage equal to 94 (+72% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 4% of the target's lost HP) per stack.

bruno.name: Mecha Legs
bruno.description: Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks). Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

bruno.name: Volley Shot
bruno.description: Bruno kicks a Powerball on his next Basic Attack, gaining 1 Movement Speed for 48%s. It deals 75 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target, and slows them by 30% for 0.5s. The Powerball then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the Powerball for another attack and reduce the cooldown of Slide by 1s.

bruno.name: Slide
bruno.description: Bruno slides forward, briefly stunning enemies along the way, and gaining a Powerball at the end of the dash.

bruno.name: Worldie
bruno.description: Bruno kicks an Energy Ball at a target hero, dealing 200 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. It knocks them back to the edge of Bruno's attack range, stuns them for 0.5s, and slows them by 80% for 2s. The Energy Ball then bounces among enemy units (up to 10 times), prioritizing enemy heroes. Each bounce deals 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

carmilla.name: Vampire Pact
carmilla.description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 6-13 Hybrid Defense (scales with level) from them. The stolen Hybrid Defense can stack up to 5 times and lasts 5s. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 3s.

carmilla.name: Crimson Flower
carmilla.description: Carmilla summons three Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5s, dealing 85 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 6% for 0.8s (the slow effect stacks up to 30%). Carmilla recovers 45 (+21% Total Magic Power) HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting minions).

carmilla.name: Bloodbath
carmilla.description: Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5s. Use Again: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.6s. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).

carmilla.name: Curse of Blood
carmilla.description: Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8s, enemies still within the area will take 450 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and will be immobilized for 1s, slowed by 30% and linked for 5s. When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.

cecilion.name: Overflowing
cecilion.description: Cecilion gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana each time his skill hits an enemy. Cooldown: 1s. Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.

cecilion.name: Bat Impact
cecilion.description: Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive at the target location, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 85 (+70% Total Magic Power) (+7% Total Mana) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. The bat also deals 170 (+140% Total Magic Power) (+14% Total Mana) extra Magic Damage to those near the landing point, and applies Overflowing effect once. Each subsequent cast within 6s increases this skill's Mana cost by 1.5 times (up to 4 stacks).

cecilion.name: Sanguine Claws
cecilion.description: Cecilion summons a pair of opposing claws at the target location that will clasp together after a short delay, pulling enemies in their paths to the center while dealing them 200 (+45% Total Magic Power) (+1.2% Total Mana) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 1s.

cecilion.name: Bats Feast
cecilion.description: Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, gaining 60% Movement Speed (decays over the duration) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s. Meanwhile, he fires 36 bolts of blood energy at nearby enemies, each dealing 35 (+8% Total Magic Power) (+0.3% Total Mana) Magic Damage and slowing enemies hit by 3% for 1s (up to 30%total). Each bolt that hits restores HP equal to 10 plus 1% of Cecilion's lost HP.

chang-e.name: Trouble Maker
chang-e.description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them that reduces their Movement Speed by 1% (up to 20%).

chang-e.name: Starmoon Shockwave
chang-e.description: Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing 350 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5s. Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon sends 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage and slowing enemies hit. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).

chang-e.name: Crescent Moon
chang-e.description: Chang'e summons the Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 10% Movement Speed until the shield is broken. Each time she casts a skill, she gains an extra 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s. Crescent Moon: Enhances her Basic Attacks to deal 20 (+35% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage 2 times. Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks or skills, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.2s.

chang-e.name: Meteor Shower
chang-e.description: Chang'e gains 10% Movement Speed for 4s. During this time, she fires 30 meteors in the target direction, each dealing 60 (+21% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to minions and creeps. Crescent Moon: Fires meteors alongside Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.

chip.name: Snack Time!
chip.description: While out of combat, Chip takes a bite of potato chips every 2s. After 4 bites, he finishes a bag and recovers HP equal to 300 (+ 45% of his lost HP). After finishing a bag, Chip cannot eat again for 5s. (His bite count is retained if he enters combat before finishing the bag.)

chip.name: Crash Course
chip.description: Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing Magic Damage equal to 100 plus 4% of the target's HP and applying Chip's Mark on enemy units hit. Chip gains a 300 (+60% Total Magic Power) Shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark, detonating the mark to deal 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun each target for 0.6s.

chip.name: Overtime
chip.description: Chip rushes for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2s. Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back slightly.

chip.name: Shortcut
chip.description: Chip drops the Main Portal on an enemy hero, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2 times the damage and immobilizes them for 1s after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates Connecting Portals near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The Main Portal and Connecting Portals last up to 15s. Connecting Portal: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from Connecting Portals to the Main Portal, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5s and a 500 shield. Main Portal: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the Main Portal for 2s to return to the Connecting Portal they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time.

chou.name: Only Fast
chou.description: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit), briefly slows the target by 90%, and reduces their Physical Defense by 10 (+1*Hero Level) for 3s (up to 2 stacks).

chou.name: Jeet Kune Do
chou.description: Chou strikes in the target direction, dealing 180 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before it goes on cooldown. On the 3rd cast, Chou also knocks enemies hit airborne. Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd cast resets the cooldown of Shunpo.

chou.name: Shunpo
chou.description: Chou charges in the target direction, gaining Control Immunity and a 200 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield.

chou.name: The Way of Dragon
chou.description: Chou strikes a roundhouse kick at the target enemy hero, dealing them 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back. Cast the skill again to chase up the target, dealing a total of 480 (+240% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

cici.name: Performer's Delight
cici.description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 1.25% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

cici.name: Yo-Yo Blitz
cici.description: Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5s, hitting them up to 10 times, and dealing Physical Damage equal to 65 plus 3.5 (+1.2% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack. If there is no enemy within range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead. This skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.

cici.name: Buoyant Bounce
cici.description: Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals 200 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.

cici.name: Curtain Call
cici.description: Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together for 4s. During this time, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one target is within the range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25%.

claude.name: Battle Side-by-side
claude.description: Dexter assists Claude on each of his Basic Attacks, dealing 25 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the same target (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).

claude.name: Art of Thievery
claude.description: Claude emits a disruption wave in the target direction, dealing 250 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area, reducing their Movement Speed by 20% and Attack Speed by 10%. For each enemy hit, he gains 4% Movement and Attack Speed (doubled if hitting enemy heroes) for 6s (up to 5 stacks).

claude.name: Battle Mirror Image
claude.description: Claude conjures a mirror image of Dexter at the target location that automatically attacks nearby enemies for 5.5s. The mirror image's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and trigger Claude's Attack Effects. Use Again: Claude switches places with the mirror image.

claude.name: Blazing Duet
claude.description: Claude and Dexter rapidly fire at nearby enemies for 3s, dealing 40 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to up to two enemies with each shot (counts as Basic Attack Damage). Claude also gains a 20 (+3% Total Physical Attack) shield each time the Ultimate deals damage to an enemy.

clint.name: Double Shot
clint.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This damage can trigger Attack Effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.

clint.name: Quick Draw
clint.description: Clint rapidly fires 5 bullets in the target direction, each dealing 250 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit. The bullets spread evenly across a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets take reduced damage from each bullet after the first.

clint.name: Trapping Recoil
clint.description: Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140 (+30% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

clint.name: Grenade Bombardment
clint.description: Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s. Clint gains a grenade charge every 10s (up to 3).

cyclops.name: Starlit Hourglass
cyclops.description: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5s.

cyclops.name: Stardust Shock
cyclops.description: Cyclops casts two Stardust Disks in the target direction, each dealing 240 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

cyclops.name: Planets Attack
cyclops.description: Cyclops conjures Starlit Spheres around himself, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s. The Starlit Spheres automatically seek and attack nearby enemies (prioritizing enemy heroes), and explode on contact to deal 200 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Subsequent hits on the same target deal reduced damage.

cyclops.name: Star Power Lockdown
cyclops.description: Cyclops creates a Planetary Sphere that tracks the target enemy hero or creep, dealing 500 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 0.75-1.5s (scales with Planetary Sphere's travel distance).

diggie.name: Young Again
diggie.description: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and returns to egg form, allowing him to move and use a new set of skills. He is untargetable in egg form and revives at his current location.

diggie.name: Auto Alarm Bomb
diggie.description: Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location that remains stationary for 25s or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals 350 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slows them by 30%. Diggie gains 2 stacks of Dangerous Sparks each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. He loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in egg form. Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

diggie.name: Reverse Time
diggie.description: Diggie marks the target enemy hero for 4s and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing 150 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and briefly slowing them by 80%. If the enemy moves out of the circle, the pull will be triggered early.

diggie.name: Time Journey
diggie.description: Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them a 650 (+300% Total Magic Power) shield and Control Immunity for 2s. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5s.

dyrroth.name: Wrath of the Abyss
dyrroth.description: When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will enhance Burst Strike - Abyss Enhanced and Spectre Step - Abyss Enhanced. After each 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth will release Circle Strike, dealing (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the circle and regenerating [50 + 40% of the damage dealt HP] (Circle Strike doesn't have ATK Effect). Each time he hits an enemy hero, the CD of Burst Strike and Spectre Step will be decreased by 1 second.

dyrroth.name: Burst Strike
dyrroth.description: Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 240 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5s. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75% on minions.) Abyss Enhanced: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled.

dyrroth.name: Spectre Step
dyrroth.description: Dyrroth dashes in the target direction. He stops upon reaching the max distance or hitting an enemy hero or creep, dealing 230 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slightly knocking them back. Use Again: Dyrroth locks onto a target and unleashes a Fatal Strike, dealing 345 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 40% for 4s. Abyss Enhanced: Fatal Strike reaches further and deals 150% of the original damage, slows the target by an extra 90%, and reduces their Physical Defense by 60% for 4s.

dyrroth.name: Abysm Strike
dyrroth.description: After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the target direction, dealing 650 (+250% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 25% of the target's lost HP) as Physical Damage to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 55% for 0.8s. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression. Damage dealt to non-hero enemies is capped at 1500.

edith.name: Overload
edith.description: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become Overloaded for 3 seconds, during which all Basic Attacks will trigger chain lightning, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to (+30% Total Magic Power) (+4-8% of target's Max HP) to up to 4 enemies. Chain lightning damage against Minions is increased to 150%.

edith.name: Earth Shatter
edith.description: After a 0.75s delay, Edith controls Phylax to launch an earth-shattering blow in a designated direction, dealing 225 (+10% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies hit (deals 120% damage to minions) and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

edith.name: Onward
edith.description: Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing 90 (+3% Max HP) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. If Phylax hits an enemy hero during the charge, it will stop immediately and throw them over its shoulder, dealing 108 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage.

edith.name: Primal Wrath
edith.description: Passive: When inside Phylax, Edith accumulates Wrath by dealing skill damage to enemies and taking damage (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects herself forward from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies and taking flight for up to 8s (gaining 30 Movement Speed). During this time, she gains new skills and can perform ranged Basic Attacks, each dealing 35 (+75% Total Physical Attack) (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. She also gains 350 (+5% Max HP) - 350 (+20% Max HP) extra shield, 50% - 150% extra Attack Speed, and 5% - 20% Hybrid Lifesteal based on accumulated Wrath, and converts each point of Extra Physical Defense and Extra Magic Defense into 3.5 Magic Power.

esmeralda.name: Starmoon Casket
esmeralda.description: Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 100 (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.[amount/conversion rate unknown]

esmeralda.name: Frostmoon Shield
esmeralda.description: Esmeralda gains a 500 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and 40% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 4s. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her HP.

esmeralda.name: Stardust Dance
esmeralda.description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and 300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of Frostmoon Shield is reduced by 1.5s (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5s reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% for 1.5s.

esmeralda.name: Falling Starmoon
esmeralda.description: Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range. Use Again: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing 350 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and then blinks to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1s.

estes.name: Scripture of the Moon Elf
estes.description: Scripture of the Moon Elf gradually charges energy into Estes. Upon reaching 100 stacks, Estes' next Basic Attack is enhanced, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target. The enhanced attack also bounces to nearby enemies, dealing 125 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 60% for 1.5s.

estes.name: Moonlight Immersion
estes.description: Estes immediately recovers 200 (+110% Total Magic Power) HP for the target allied hero and links himself with them for 5s. While linked, both heroes gain 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) Hybrid Defense, and the target slowly recovers 360 (+90% Total Magic Power) HP. The link increases Estes' Movement Speed by 15% and the energy charge rate of the Scripture of the Moon Elf. The link breaks if Estes moves too far from the target.

estes.name: Domain of Moon Goddess
estes.description: Estes calls down a flood of moonlight on the target area, dealing 350 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemy units within it. The area then becomes a Domain of Moon Goddess, revealing enemies within. Enemies that touch the domain's edge are slowed by 90% for 1.5s. The slow effect decays over time.

estes.name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
estes.description: Estes casts an enhanced Moonlight Immersion on himself and all nearby allied heroes, refreshing Moonlight Immersion on them and enhancing it for 8s. Enhanced Moonlight Immersion: Doubles the Instant Basic Healing and Hybrid Defense Increase, and heals the target for 1020 (+225% Total Magic Power) HP over time.

eudora.name: Superconductor
eudora.description: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor for 5s on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

eudora.name: Forked Lightning
eudora.description: Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within. When hitting targets affected by Superconductor, Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target, gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1s. The lightning chain deals 10 (+4% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage over time and an additional 275 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces this skill's cooldown by 50%.

eudora.name: Ball Lightning
eudora.description: Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their Magic Defense by 10 for 1.8s, dealing 300 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, and stunning them for 1s. If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces nearby enemies' Magic Defense, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

eudora.name: Thunder’s Wrath
eudora.description: Eudora calls down lightning on the target area, dealing 540 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to targets at the center. A second strike then deals 270 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the outer area. When Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst at the target's location after a short delay, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them.

fanny.name: Air Superiority
fanny.description: While flying, Fanny deals 10%-20% extra damage to enemies hit based on her flying speed and applies 1 stack of Prey Mark with each hit (up to 2 stacks). Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack. Energy restoration is reduced when multiple enemy heroes are hit within a short period.

fanny.name: Tornado Strike
fanny.description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies.

fanny.name: Steel Cable
fanny.description: Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction, pulling herself toward the first obstacle it hits. She can recast this skill within 2s as long as she has enough energy. Each successive cast during this period costs 2 less energy. While flying, Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike when she hits an enemy if she has enough Energy.

fanny.name: Cut Throat
fanny.description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Each stack of Prey Mark on the target increases this damage by 30%.

faramis.name: Vicious Retrieval
faramis.description: When Faramis's skills deal damage to enemy heroes and summoned units, they leave behind Soul Fragments. Absorbing a Soul Fragment recovers 100 (+50% Total Magic Power) HP and grants 2 Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed Soul Fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). He can gain up to 1 Soul Fragment from the same enemy hero using skills every 4s. Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop Soul Fragments.

faramis.name: Shadow Stampede
faramis.description: Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% Movement Speed, 25 Hybrid Defense, and 20% Cooldown Reduction of this skill. He also gains the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes he touches take 250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are marked with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis pulls all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Use Again: Ends the Shadow state early to pull marked enemy heroes toward him. Soul Fragment absorption range is increased while this skill is active.

faramis.name: Ghost Bursters
faramis.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330 (+144% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+86% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

faramis.name: Nether Realm
faramis.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the Nether Realm for 6s. Allied heroes within (including himself) enter the Specter state, gaining 400 (+ 10 (+5% Total Magic Power)%) extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the Specter state breaks, heroes within clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. The Specter state immediately ends if the allied hero leaves the Nether Realm.

floryn.name: Dew
floryn.description: Dew's Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount. After leaving combat for 5s, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30s cooldown), which will grant them a 100 (+70% Total Magic Power) shield each time they are healed by Floryn. Floryn will never sell the Lantern.

floryn.name: Sow
floryn.description: Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at the target enemy, dealing 180 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their HP by 175 (+90% Total Magic Power).

floryn.name: Sprout
floryn.description: Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 175 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5s (and revealing their positions briefly).

floryn.name: Bloom
floryn.description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, recovering 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) HP for all allied heroes 2 time(s) no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regen effects by 12% for 2s.

franco.name: Wasteland Force
franco.description: If Franco takes no damage for 5s, he gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% HP per second, and begins gaining Wasteland Force (up to 10 stacks). Franco's next skill consumes all Wasteland Force stacks, increasing its damage by up to 150%.

franco.name: Iron Hook
franco.description: Franco launches an Iron Hook in the target direction. The hook snags the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and dragging them to him.

franco.name: Fury Shock
franco.description: Franco lashes out, dealing 300 (+ 4% of his HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies, slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

franco.name: Bloody Hunt
franco.description: Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

fredrinn.name: Crystalline Armor
fredrinn.description: Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimates cost different numbers of Combo Points. Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% HP per second. Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

fredrinn.name: Piercing Strike
fredrinn.description: Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125 (+7% Max HP) (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This skill deals 170% damage to non-hero enemies.

fredrinn.name: Brave Assault
fredrinn.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.

fredrinn.name: Energy Eruption
fredrinn.description: Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault by 75%. This skill costs 1 Combo Point.

freya.name: Power of Einherjar
freya.description: Freya gains 1 Sacred Orb stack(s) with each Basic Attack (up to 6 stacks). Consuming 1 stack(s) of Sacred Orb grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack and recovers 20 (+3*Hero Level) (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP (up to 6 stacks). While out of combat, Sacred Orb stacks are gradually restored.

freya.name: Leap of Faith
freya.description: Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining 500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield and dealing 200 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4s.

freya.name: Valkyrie Slash
freya.description: Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5s. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Sacred Orbs per cast. This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

freya.name: Valkyrie Descent
freya.description: Freya dives toward the target area, gaining Control Immunity. She deals 300 (+75% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along her path and in the landing area. Enemies hit are slowed by 40% for 2s. Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 10s and gains 30 Movement Speed. Her Basic Attacks deal 100 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Splash Damage (only the bonus Physical Damage can Crit).

gatotkaca.name: Steel Bones
gatotkaca.description: Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 100). He gains 5 Rage (up to 100)For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before reduction). Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (+200% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (8.2-11* Consumed Rage) Magic Damage and recover (8 * Consumed Rage) HP.

gatotkaca.name: Blast Iron Fist
gatotkaca.description: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per second and be slowed by 30%.

gatotkaca.name: Unbreakable
gatotkaca.description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, taunting enemies on the path to attack him, dealing 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 0.9 - 1.5s. The taunt duration and sprint distance scale with the channel time. Canceling the skill reduces 50% of the remaining cooldown.

gatotkaca.name: Avatar of the Guardian
gatotkaca.description: Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500 (+300% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center. The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

gloo.name: Stick, Stick
gloo.description: Gloo's skills apply a stack of Sticky to enemies on hit, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s (up to 5 stacks). Each Sticky stack on an attacker reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 3%.

gloo.name: Slam, Slam
gloo.description: Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit. A Goo is left at the end location, which explodes after 3s, dealing 230 (+11% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilizing them for 0.6s. Touching the Goo detonates it immediately and resets this skill's cooldown. Gloo also recovers 2.5% HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).

gloo.name: Spread, Spread
gloo.description: Gloo splits into Goos, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. For the next 4s, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies it touches. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo charges toward it, dragging enemies in its path along for a distance.

gloo.name: Grab, Grab
gloo.description: Unlocked when an enemy hero reaches max Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target for up to 9s, recovering 20% HP. While attached, Gloo's Basic Attacks deal 30 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+6% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage, and it transfers 60% of the damage it takes (excluding Turret damage) to the host. If the host dies while Gloo is attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5s.

gord.name: Mystic Favor
gord.description: After Gord hits the same target 4 times with skills in quick succession, his next skill deals 120 (+8*Hero Level) (+40% Total Magic Power) extra True Damage and slows them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

gord.name: Mystic Projectile
gord.description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225 (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.

gord.name: Mystic Injunction
gord.description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 30 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies within (up to 16 times).

gord.name: Mystic Gush
gord.description: Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 90 (+32% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times). The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

granger.name: Capriccio
granger.description: Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons start with 800 max Energy. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Killing a Minion / Creep permanently increases their max Energy by 6 / 6, and instantly restores their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Each kill or assist on an enemy hero permanently increases both weapons' max Energy by 12 and instantly restores 10% Energy. Every 1% Cooldown Reduction converts to 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy costs are not affected by Energy Cost Reduction.

granger.name: Rhapsody
granger.description: Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing 60 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last shot is guaranteed to Crit. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%. Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has no cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.

granger.name: Rondo
granger.description: Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15% Energy for his Gun. Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.

granger.name: Death Sonata
granger.description: Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot. Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

grock.name: Bastion of Stone
grock.description: Grock gains a shield equal to 14% HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% target's HP Physical Damage (capped at 300 (+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). Cooldown: 18s - 12s (decreases with level). This cooldown is reduced by 200% when near terrain. Grock's skills cannot be interrupted, and he gains 30 (+6*Hero Level)% extra Physical Defense while the shield is active.

grock.name: Mighty Swing
grock.description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked back into the obstacle, knocked airborne, and take 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% HP extra Physical Damage (capped at 300 (+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

grock.name: Earthen Rampart
grock.description: After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies towards him. Use Again: Cancel the wall early.

grock.name: Tectonic Charge
grock.description: Grock charges forward and gains Control Immunity, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1s and deals 650 (+300% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

guinevere.name: Super Magic
guinevere.description: Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies and deals (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks. Guinevere builds up Super Magic each time she deals damage and when she's fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage on hit and restoring 80 (+8% of Guinevere's Lost HP) HP. Enemies hit by Guinevere's enhanced Basic Attack, Energy Wave, or Spatial Migration are marked for 5 seconds. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.

guinevere.name: Energy Wave
guinevere.description: Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.

guinevere.name: Spatial Migration
guinevere.description: Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125 (+50% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage. Use Again: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

guinevere.name: Violet Requiem
guinevere.description: Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880 (+385% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total. Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.

gusion.name: Dagger Specialist
gusion.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's HP and recover 50 (+25% Total Magic Power) HP for himself.

gusion.name: Sword Spike
gusion.description: Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them. Use Again: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

gusion.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
gusion.description: Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%). Use Again: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

gusion.name: Incandescence
gusion.description: Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaughter was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward. Use Again: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.

hanabi.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
hanabi.description: Hanabi's Basic Attacks and skills launch Petal Blades upon hitting a target, dealing 30% damage and bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies. Petal Blades launched by Basic Attacks inherit Attack Effects. If bounces from the same Basic Attack or skill hit the same target multiple times, subsequent bounces deal 30% less damage.

hanabi.name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
hanabi.description: Passive: Whenever Hanabi has a shield from any source, she is immune to control effects. Active: Hanabi gains a 300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s. When the shield is active, she gains 20% Movement Speed and 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of her damage dealt to enemy heroes is added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units is added). This shield cannot exceed 50% of her HP.

hanabi.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
hanabi.description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1s. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on them with no damage decay.

hanabi.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
hanabi.description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s. After 1s, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decay to 30% damage.

hanzo.name: Ame no Habakiri
hanzo.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

hanzo.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
hanzo.description: The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP. When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, recovers 150 (+80% Total Physical Attack) HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

hanzo.name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
hanzo.description: Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals 90 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit). The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

hanzo.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
hanzo.description: Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position. While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, while Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed. Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 360 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) HP and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6s, and the skill's cooldown will be doubled.

harith.name: Key Insight
harith.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

harith.name: Synchro Fission
harith.description: Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing 150 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemy units on the path.
