popol-and-kupa.description: Popol throws a spear at the target, signaling Kupa to attack and dealing 80 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa then bites the target, dealing 40 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 99% for 0.75s. While marked by the spear, whenever Popol or Kupa hits the target with a Basic Attack, both gain 7% Attack Speed and 3% Movement Speed for 4s (up to 3 stacks). Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa strikes fiercely, dealing 120 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

popol-and-kupa.name: Kupa, Help!
popol-and-kupa.description: Popol calls Kupa back and gains a 240 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield. He can then ride Kupa for 1.5s, gaining 250 Movement Speed while mounted. Kupa also continuously recovers 20% of its Max HP. Popol can use a Basic Attack to end the Mounted state early. After returning, Kupa follows Popol until Popol attacks an enemy. Alpha Wolf Form: Shield effect increases to 125%, and Kupa recovers full HP while Mounted.

popol-and-kupa.name: We Are Angry!
popol-and-kupa.description: Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 9s. During this time, Kupa turns into Alpha Wolf Form.

rafaela.name: Divine Resurrection
rafaela.description: Rafaela can cast a special skill every 10s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown). This skill's cooldown is increased by 600% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

rafaela.name: Light of Retribution
rafaela.description: Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with Light of Retribution, dealing them 350 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

rafaela.name: Holy Healing
rafaela.description: Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, recovering 100 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150 (+65% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s. Every 10 Magic Power increases the Movement Speed bonus by 1%.

rafaela.name: Holy Baptism
rafaela.description: Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light in the target direction, dealing 460 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

roger.name: Full Moon Curse
roger.description: Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms. In human form, Roger's attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP. In wolf form, his attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's [lost C6HP]. Extra damage against creeps is capped at 60.

roger.name: Open Fire
roger.description: Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing a total of 250 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s. The second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 10 for 5s.

roger.name: Hunter's Steps
roger.description: Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

roger.name: Wolf Transformation
roger.description: Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s. Passive: In wolf form, Roger gains 20 Hybrid Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

ruby.name: Let's Dance!
ruby.description: Ruby's skills have a 75% Spell Vamp Ratio (her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). For every 1% HP lost, her Spell Vamp Ratio increases by 1%, up to 150%. After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 8-25 Hybrid Defense (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

ruby.name: Be Good!
ruby.description: Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 280 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

ruby.name: Don't Run, Wolf King!
ruby.description: Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.

ruby.name: I'm Offended!
ruby.description: Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 600 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.

saber.name: Enemy's Bane
saber.description: Each time Saber deals damage, he reduces the target's Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

saber.name: Orbiting Swords
saber.description: Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 75 (+25% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after the duration. While active, Sword attacks deal 200 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack reduces the cooldowns of Orbiting Swords by 0.5s and Charge by 1s.

saber.name: Charge
saber.description: Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. After the dash, he gains an Enhanced Basic Attack that allows him to charge at the target, dealing 75 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

saber.name: Triple Sweep
saber.description: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). He strikes them 3 times over the duration, dealing 120 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the first 2 strikes and 240 (+160% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the third.

selena.name: Symbiosis
selena.description: Selena can switch freely between her two forms. Elven Form: Selena applies "Abyssal Mark" with her skills. The mark can stack up to 2 times. When Abyssal Trap hits an enemy, it immediately adds an "Abyssal Mark". Abyssal Form: All damage will consume 1 stack of "Abyssal Mark" to deal 225 (+15*Hero Level) (+40% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage. "Abyssal Mark" deals 285% extra damage to non-hero units.

selena.name: Abyssal Trap
selena.description: Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk underground. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches, inflicting a stack of Abyssal Mark and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. The Abyssal Devil then explodes, dealing 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. Each additional Abyssal Devil on an enemy increases the final damage by 50%. Each Abyssal Devil can lurk up to 60s and up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time.

selena.name: Abyssal Arrow
selena.description: Selena fires an abyssal wraith in the target direction that stops when it hits an enemy hero, Creep, or Summon, dealing 250 (+20% Total Magic Power) to 500 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target hit and stunning them for 0.5s to 2.5s while revealing their locations (the damage and stun duration increase with the wraith's travel distance). The wraith will pick up Abyssal Trap as it travels over it and will apply the trap to the enemy target upon stunning them. If the wraith stuns an enemy for 0.9s or longer, Selena will gain 60% Movement Speed for 2s.

selena.name: Primal Darkness
selena.description: Passive: Selena gains 5 Magic Power. Active: Selena enters Abyssal Form and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Soul Eater and Garotte.

silvanna.name: Knightess' Resolve
silvanna.description: Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5s on hit, each mark reducing their Hybrid Defense by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks). Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.

silvanna.name: Cometic Lance
silvanna.description: Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s.

silvanna.name: Spiral Strangling
silvanna.description: Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield. Each spin deals 165 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses. The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions. Spiral Strangling counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

silvanna.name: Imperial Justice
silvanna.description: Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.) Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Lifesteal when in the Circle.

sora.name: Mystic Surge
sora.description: Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent by using his Ultimate. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. Upon reaching 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art. Thunder: Adopts an assassin style, converting 30% HP into Physical Attack (Equal to 10% of HP). Torrent: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% Physical Attack into HP (Gains 10 HP for every 1 Attack).

sora.name: Sundering Strike
sora.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage. He can dash after striking.

sora.name: Windstride
sora.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional 140 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2s.

sora.name: Shifting Skies
sora.description: Swipe left to ascend into Thunder for 10s. Sora gains a brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), each dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Swipe right to ascend into Torrent for 10s. Sora gains Control Immunity. After a short delay, he pulls nearby enemies in and deals 250 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage.

sun.name: Simian God
sun.description: Enemies hit by Sun or his Doppelgangers will have their Physical Defense reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 15% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage. Sun or his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 65 extra damage to creeps.

sun.name: Endless Variety
sun.description: Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 280 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Upon hitting an enemy hero or creep, or upon reaching maximum range, the Golden Staff transforms into a Doppelganger that pursues enemies. The Doppelganger inherits Sun's attributes, deals 60% of Sun's damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s. This skill shares its level and cooldown with Swift Exchange.

sun.name: Swift Exchange
sun.description: Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 280 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. He conjures a Doppelganger at his location that inherits his attributes, deals 60% damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s. Sun transforms into the Golden Staff and becomes concealed, reappearing at its maximum range.

sun.name: Clone Techniques
sun.description: Sun summons a Doppelganger that inherits his attributes, deals 80% damage, and takes 120% damage for 8s.

suyou.name: Transient Immortal
suyou.description: Tap-casting any skill puts Suyou in Mortal Form, granting 40 Movement Speed and reducing the interval between his Basic Attacks. Hold-casting any skill puts Suyou in Immortal Form, increasing his Basic Attack damage to 125% and granting 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In this form, Suyou gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction for every 20 extra Physical Attack he has, up to 40%.

suyou.name: Blade Surge
suyou.description: Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with the hold time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

suyou.name: Soul Sever
suyou.description: Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing Physical Damage equal to 280 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 15% of target's lost HP) to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Hold: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 225 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the final strike deals 360 (+128% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovers 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) HP for himself.

suyou.name: Evil Queller
suyou.description: Tap: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path backward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s. Hold: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

terizla.name: Body of Smith
terizla.description: Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1*Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost. He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed into 1 Physical Attack.

terizla.name: Revenge Strike
terizla.description: Terizla strikes the ground with his hammer, sending a fissure forward that deals 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting its first target, the fissure burrows into them, slowing them by 15%. Terizla also gains 15% Movement Speed for 3.5s. The fissure then explodes, dealing 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 20% of the target's lost HP) Physical Damage.

terizla.name: Execution Strike
terizla.description: Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90 (+135% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third deals 225 (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.25s (the Slowing Effect can stack). Deals only 80% damage to Minions.

terizla.name: Penalty Zone
terizla.description: Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time.

thamuz.name: Grand Lord Lava
thamuz.description: Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a chance of 10%–60% (scaling with Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55 (+60% Total Physical Attack)(+8*Hero Level) True Damage. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy increase Thamuz's Lava's Rage. While Thamuz is without his Scythes, he gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy.

thamuz.name: Molten Scythes
thamuz.description: Thamuz tosses Scythes in the target direction. After traveling a set distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s. After leaving Thamuz for a short time or reaching a set distance, the Scythes return to him, dragging enemies along their path toward Thamuz. Thamuz can move toward the Scythes or cast the skill again to retrieve them.

thamuz.name: Chasm Trample
thamuz.description: Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2s upon landing. If the Scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.

thamuz.name: Cauterant Inferno
thamuz.description: Thamuz spouts the lava within, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Zone around himself. The Cauterant Zone lasts 9s and deals 30 (+10% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s to enemies in the area. Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800 (+50% Extra Max HP) HP, immediately healing for the same amount, and gains 60% Attack Speed. Each time his Basic Attacks or Scythes deal damage, he recovers 1.5% Max HP.

tigreal.name: Fearless
tigreal.description: Tigreal gains 1 stack of Fearless each time he is hit by a Basic Attack. At 4 stacks, he consumes them to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from Turrets). He also gains 1 stack of Fearless each time he casts a skill. Damage from minions does not add or consume Fearless stacks.

tigreal.name: Attack Wave
tigreal.description: Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer, sending a shockwave that erupts 3 times in a fan-shaped area. Each eruption deals 270 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slows them by 20% / 40% / 60% for 1.5s.

tigreal.name: Sacred Hammer
tigreal.description: Tigreal charges in a target direction, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge. Used Again: Tigreal can cast this skill again within 4 seconds, dealing 280-380 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 1 second.

tigreal.name: Implosion
tigreal.description: Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, pulling nearby enemies to him, dealing 600 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1.8s. The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects, while the second half can only be interrupted by Suppression.

uranus.name: Radiance
uranus.description: Uranus absorbs the energy generated by incoming attacks to strengthen theirself, regenerating a certain amount of HP every 0.8s. Each stack lasts 10s. When at max stacks (20), Uranus regenerates 48-224 HP (scales with level).

uranus.name: Ionic Edge
uranus.description: Uranus releases 2 energy blades that orbit around him, dealing 155 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+6 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. Each blade can only damage the same target once.

uranus.name: Transcendent Ward
uranus.description: Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, and 160 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300 (+200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s. The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby.

uranus.name: Consecration
uranus.description: Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time). Uranus directly gains 5 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

vale.name: Windtalk
vale.description: Vale gains 1 stack of Windtalk each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.

vale.name: Wind Blade
vale.description: Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area, each dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

vale.name: Windblow
vale.description: Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing 350 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, it will remain for 1.6s while continuously dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in range.

vale.name: Windstorm
vale.description: Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1s, the windstorm will explode, dealing 900 (+240% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.

valentina.name: Primal Force
valentina.description: Valentina gains 8-50 extra EXP (scales with level) each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2s. If the enemy hero's level is not higher than hers, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP.

valentina.name: Shadow Strike
valentina.description: Valentina casts Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing 475 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4s. Marked enemies hit by Shadow Strike again are Terrified for 1s (a target can only be terrified once every 4s).

valentina.name: Arcane Shade
valentina.description: Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 90 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each. She can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana). Each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy, the cooldown of Shadow Strike is reduced by 1s.

valentina.name: I Am You
valentina.description: Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5s and gains the ability to cast their Ultimate. Casting the enemy's Ultimate turns her into the enemy hero's form and inherits their Basic Attack type for up to 12s (her regular skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's Ultimate has a Morph effect). The stolen Ultimate's level equals Valentina's own Ultimate level, and its cooldown is 120% of the target's (but no lower than 10s). If the target is a Physical Damage hero, Valentina gains (+100% Total Magic Power) Physical Attack for the duration. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.

valir.name: Ashing
valir.description: Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 1 (+0.2% Total Magic Power)% of their HP per second for 3s. At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage equal to 5 (+1% Total Magic Power)% of the target's HP and stunning them for 1s. A target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.

valir.name: Burst Fireball
valir.description: Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The flame on the ground explodes after 1s, dealing 118 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s (up to 2 charges). Hitting an enemy hero or legend creep with this skill immediately restores 1 charge, while hitting a minion restores 4s of the recharge time. Vengeance Flame: Increases the cast range of Burst Fireball by 30%.

valir.name: Searing Torrent
valir.description: Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back to the end of its path. Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 1s. Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

valir.name: Vengeance Flame
valir.description: Valir removes all debuffs on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s. Meanwhile, he conjures 4 Vengeance Flames that enhance Burst Fireball and Searing Torrent for 9s.

vexana.name: Nether Touch
vexana.description: Vexana and her Eternal Guard inflict Nether Touch on enemies hit. The mark lasts 5s and causes the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

vexana.name: Deathly Grasp
vexana.description: Vexana unleashes a Deathly Grasp in the target direction, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. It stops upon hitting an enemy hero, Terrifying and knocking them back. After a short delay, it explodes, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and Terrifying them for 1s.

vexana.name: Cursed Blast
vexana.description: Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580 (+165% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

vexana.name: Eternal Guard
vexana.description: Vexana summons an Eternal Guard at the target location, dealing 480 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. The Eternal Guard then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Its attacks deal 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's HP) Magic Damage and Splash Damage in a large area.

wanwan.name: Tiger Pace
wanwan.description: Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67 (+3*Hero Level) extra True Damage and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s. Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

wanwan.name: Swallow’s Path
wanwan.description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.

wanwan.name: Needles in Flowers
wanwan.description: Wanwan removes all debuffs on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

wanwan.name: Crossbow of Tang
wanwan.description: Wanwan leaps into the air and becomes untargetable, firing arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration. Crossbow of Tang can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

x-borg.name: Firaga Armor
x-borg.description: Firaga Armor inherits 160% of X.Borg's HP and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the direction of the Joystick (he is invincible during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% HP. X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter the Overheated state. Enemies in the Overheated state will drop Firaga Supplies when they take damage from X.Borg. Picking up supplies restores 10% of the Armor's HP (or 10 Energy while in the Armorless State). X.Borg's skills deal True Damage to enemies in the Overheated state.

x-borg.name: Fire Missiles
x-borg.description: X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25 (+60% Total Physical Attack) (+40% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 7 times over 2s to enemies in front of him (75% damage to minions). Armorless State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

x-borg.name: Fire Stake
x-borg.description: X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes forward and recalls them after 1.7s. Each stake deals 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and pulls enemies and Firaga Supplies along its path back to him. Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake launcher, making the stakes travel farther and closer together.

x-borg.name: Last Insanity
x-borg.description: X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire (cannot pick up Firaga Supplies during this time), dealing 90 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) (+45% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 12 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon touching an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3s, his mecha suit detonates, dealing 300 (+ 15% target's HP) True Damage. If his armor is destroyed, it will immediately explode, but damage drops to 50%. The detonation destroys his armor, removes all control effects, and collects all nearby Firaga Supplies. Cannot be used in Armorless State. Use Again: Immediately stop spraying fire and detonate early.

xavier.name: Transcendence
xavier.description: When Xavier's skills hit enemy heroes, he gains 60% Movement Speed for 1.2s (decays over time) and 1 energy charge. At 3 charges, his next skill triggers the Transcendence state. Transcendence: In this state, Xavier's Skills 1 and 2 have their cooldowns reduced by 4s, and his Ultimate by 36s. Transcendence lasts 5s and can be extended by 1s each time his skills hit enemies.

xavier.name: Infinite Extension
xavier.description: Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it passes through. The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).

xavier.name: Mystic Field
xavier.description: Xavier summons a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5s. Enemies touching the Barrier are slowed by 50%, while allies gain 50% extra Movement Speed (decays over 1.2s). When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a Mystic Field for 3s, dealing 440 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 0.8s.

xavier.name: Dawning Light
xavier.description: Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 600 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies along its path. Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence state and resets the state's duration.

yi-sun-shin.name: Heavenly Vow
yi-sun-shin.description: Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow or glaive based on his distance from the target. Weapon Mastery: After each weapon swap, his next 2 Basic Attacks gain extra Attack Speed and deal 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively. He also gains 15% Movement Speed for 1s.

yi-sun-shin.name: Traceless
yi-sun-shin.description: Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing 150 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and gaining Control Immunity for 0.4s. Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1s.

yi-sun-shin.name: Blood Floods
yi-sun-shin.description: Tap: Yi Sun-shin slashes swiftly with his glaive, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Hold: Yi Sun-shin shoots a powerful arrow forward, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (damage scales with hold time, up to 200%). Casting this skill immediately triggers Weapon Mastery.

yi-sun-shin.name: Mountain Shocker
yi-sun-shin.description: Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle ship and reveals the whole map for 2s. The turtle ship lasts up to 10s, during which he gains 70% burst Movement Speed (decays to 20% over 2s). Use Again: Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle ship to ram the target area, dealing 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the center and stunning them for 0.8s. Meanwhile, he commands the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon attacks over a larger area. Each wave deals 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies by 30%. Casting this skill immediately triggers Weapon Mastery.

yin.name: Leave It to Me
yin.description: If there are no allied heroes within 4 units of Yin, his damage is increased to 120% and he gains 8% Spell Vamp.

yin.name: Charged Punch
yin.description: Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3s). During this time, his next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 25 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the enhanced Basic Attack hits an enemy, Yin throws a charged punch forward, dealing 360 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Successfully throwing the charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown by 35%.

yin.name: Instant Blast
yin.description: Yin dashes forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit. After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Yin, dealing 150 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.

yin.name: My Turn
yin.description: After a short delay, Yin locks onto an enemy hero (cannot lock onto pets or clones) and pulls them into a domain for up to 8s and turns into Lieh. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills. Lieh has stronger skills and 50 extra Physical Defense and Magic Defense that last 8s. The domain will end early if either of the two is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll recover 20% of his Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8s. If Yin fails to pull his target into the domain, the skill will enter a 3s cooldown.

yu-zhong.name: Cursing Touch
yu-zhong.description: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes every time he deals Physical damage to them. Sha Residue erupts upon reaching 5 stacks a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4 seconds to deal Physical Damage equal to 20 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) (+2.5% of target's Lost HP) to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When Sha Residue erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed by 3 seconds.

yu-zhong.name: Dragon Tail
yu-zhong.description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.

yu-zhong.name: Soul Grip
yu-zhong.description: Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s. Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of Sha Residue and deal up to 200% damage.

yu-zhong.name: Black Dragon Form
yu-zhong.description: After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use other skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He also gains 1000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form. Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

yve.name: Galactic Power
yve.description: When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 120 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s.

yve.name: Void Blast
yve.description: Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area. Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.

yve.name: Void Crystal
yve.description: Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 20%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 4% for each hit after the first hit (up to 40%).

yve.name: Real World Manipulation
yve.description: Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times. Tap: Deals 340 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area. Swipe: Deals 85 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 40%. Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target). Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

zetian.name: Celestial Armament
zetian.description: Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks). Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

zetian.name: Phoenix Strike
zetian.description: Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time. The waves deal 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), and 360 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect). The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

zetian.name: Phoenix Descent
zetian.description: Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10% while revealing their surrounding area. While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

zetian.name: Fury of the Phoenix
zetian.description: Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time. Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

zhask.name: Decimation
zhask.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

zhask.name: Nightmaric Spawn
zhask.description: Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55% of his HP, Hybrid Defense, and Magic Power. It automatically fires Death Ray at nearby enemies, dealing 55 (+ 20%Magic Power) (+ 20% Extra Attack Speed) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. It disappears when Zhask moves too far away. Death Ray is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit. Fusion Enhanced: Nightmaric Spawn deals 180% damage and can be repositioned.

zhask.name: Mind Eater
zhask.description: Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, the Nightmaric Spawn attacks enemies hit by Mind Eater, dealing 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.5s. Fusion Enhanced: Mind Eater damage is increased to 540 (+180% Total Magic Power).

zhask.name: Dominator's Descent
zhask.description: Zhask selects a target area to summon an enhanced Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra attributes. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period. Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off the Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

zhuxin.name: Crimson Butterflies
zhuxin.description: Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 5% of her Max Mana. Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

zhuxin.name: Fluttering Grace
zhuxin.description: Zhuxin deals 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

zhuxin.name: Lantern Flare
zhuxin.description: Hold: Hold the skill button to move the Spirit Lantern. It deals 35 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in range every 0.33s (Magic Bonus increases to 60% against minions) and applies Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero reaches 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s. Release: Throw all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) (+ 10% captured target's HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. If an enemy is hit multiple times, subsequent damage decays by 80%. After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% extra damage to that target.

zhuxin.name: Crimson Beacon
zhuxin.description: Zhuxin blinks to the target location, gaining a 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) shield and creating a field for 6s. The field deals 30 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

zilong.name: Dragon Flurry
zilong.description: After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP. Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.

zilong.name: Spear Flip
zilong.description: Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

zilong.name: Spear Strike
zilong.description: Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 2s. The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

zilong.name: Supreme Warrior
zilong.description: Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s. During this time, Dragon Flurry triggers every 2 attacks (instead of the previous 3).
